abstract: BACKGROUND/AIM: Choriocarcinoma is a highly aggressive trophoblastic malignancy that is most commonly gestational in origin. Non-gestational choriocarcinoma in the male gastrointestinal tract is extremely rare, and primary appendiceal involvement is exceptional. CASE REPORT: We report such a case of a 75-year-old male who presented to the emergency room with severe abdominal pain. Physical examination indicated possible acute appendicitis suspicious for perforation, and computed tomography (CT) scans revealed a 7.5 cm mass in the lower right quadrant as well as numerous liver hypoechoic nodules. No lesions/nodules were identified in his testicles or mediastinum. Emergency surgery with right hemicolectomy and concurrent liver biopsy was performed. Pathology gross exam revealed a 7.5 cm appendiceal mass with associated appendiceal perforation. Histologically, the tumor showed a poorly differentiated carcinoma morphologically composed of syncytiotrophoblasts, cytotrophoblasts and intermediate trophoblasts with adjacent low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN). The carcinoma cells were positive for cytokeratin 7 (CK7), beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG), GATA-binding protein 3 (GATA 3) and Sal-like protein 4 (SALL4). These features supported a primary appendiceal choriocarcinoma and the liver biopsy demonstrated metastasis of choriocarcinoma with extensive tumor necrosis. Post-surgery lab tests also revealed an exceptionally high serum β-hCG titer of 289,308 mIU/ml. The patient underwent hospice care after surgery and expired one month later. CONCLUSION: This is the first documented case of male primary choriocarcinoma with background of LAMN and poor prognosis. Recognition of the three carcinoma components in combination with the corresponding tumor immunohistochemical markers is the key for the precise diagnosis.

背景・目的：絨毛癌は非常に侵襲性の高い栄養膜性悪性腫瘍で、ほとんどは妊娠性である。非妊娠性絨毛癌の男性消化管での発生は極めて稀であり、原発性虫垂病変はさらに例外的である。
症例報告：75歳男性が強い腹痛で救急外来を受診した。身体所見から穿孔を伴う急性虫垂炎が疑われた。CTで右下腹部に7.5cmの腫瘤と多数の肝低エコー結節を認めた。右半結腸切除術と同時に肝生検を施行した。肉眼的病理検査では7.5cmの虫垂腫瘤と虫垂穿孔を認めた。組織学的には、合胞体栄養膜細胞、細胞性栄養膜細胞、中間型栄養膜細胞から構成される低分化癌で、隣接して低悪性度虫垂粘液性腫瘍（LAMN）を伴っていた。癌細胞はCK7、β-hCG、GATA3、SALL4が陽性であった。これらの所見から原発性虫垂絨毛癌と診断され、肝生検では絨毛癌の転移と広範な腫瘍壊死が認められた。術後の検査で血清β-hCGは289,308 mIU/mlと極めて高値であった。患者は術後に緩和ケアを受け、1か月後に死亡した。
結論：本症例は、LAMNを背景とする男性原発絨毛癌の初めての報告例であり、予後不良であった。3つの癌成分を認識し、それに対応する腫瘍免疫組織化学マーカーと組み合わせて確認することが、正確な診断の鍵である。
